name: nt2_fermat_number_prime_factor_form
statement: (n p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : ∃ k, p * k = 2 ^ 2 ^ n + 1) : ∃ m, p = m * 2 ^ (n + 1) + 1
closed: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (h : ∃ k, p * k = 2 ^ 2 ^ n + 1), ∃ m, p = m * 2 ^ (n + 1) + 1
informal: Every prime factor p of the Fermat number 2^(2^n)+1 has the form m·2^(n+1) + 1: the order of 2 mod p is exactly 2^(n+1), which divides p - 1.
